title: New Pilobol.us reader app serves the homepage body for unknown paths instead of the custom 404 page

comments.author: home
comments.text: Cause: the live reader app dssc97s4q5kgk has customRules `/<*>` -> `/index.html` (404-200) (old app d1od6t7lzbwanr has `/<*>` -> `/404.html` 404-200). The amplify-app-shell template sets NO customRules on the reader app (only on the CMS app, SPA-style index.html), and site.json has no reader.customRules key, so no site-level fix exists. Fix: template PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/137 (branch feature/PPY-a960cb-reader-404-rule): reader catch-all `/<*>` -> `/404.html` 404-200, synth test, docs. CI: ts and python pass. NOT applied: needs release, papyrusVersion pin bump in Pilobol.us site.json, then reviewed cdk diff and update of amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us-cms. Live app unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Pilobol.us PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us/pull/51 (pins 1.0.0-next.15, not merged). Stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us-cms deployed: cdk diff showed only reader buildspec (papyrus-newsroom 1.0.0.dev12 -> dev15) and reader CustomRules `/<*>` -> `/404.html` 404-200. Reader app dssc97s4q5kgk now serves custom 404 body (2322 bytes) for unknown paths; real paths and /404.html byte-identical to pilobol.us.

right_now_summary: The reader app now serves the custom 404 page for unknown paths after the fix was deployed.
